summary: Endlos-Suche (explore) fix verified. Unit: test_deep_explore_1206.py + test_deep_explore.py = 13/13 passed. Live API run (job 18a2ccfa90c7, 4 coins, 1h, 120d, max_rules 4, tpsl): phase text showed '15 verfeinert', '1/5 Champions', '75 % mit genug Trades', 'Trade-Einstellungen x/10'; finished with stop_reason=target_reached, champions_found=5 (search part 22s, total ~2 min incl. data loading). Report fields valid_pct=78.85, rescue_refined=0, trade_tuned=34, revisits=0, indicator_stats (12 items), total_space, space_seen_pct are all present. result.trade_params == champions[0].trade_params. UI: tools-menu -> optimizer -> opt-mode-explore shows the explore-report block with explore-report-stats, explore-report-diagnose and indicator hit rates (Trefferquote je Indikator), near misses, and the stop reason 'Champions-Ziel erreicht'. No page errors.

minor.issue: Champion trade_params is often {} (4 of 5 champions, 3 of 5 top5). This happens because _optimize_trade_settings returns {} when no random TP/SL combo beats the default one. That behaviour is correct, but the review expected non-empty trade_params. Because of this, result.trade_params was {} (champion #1 used the defaults) and the UI shows no TP/SL pills for these champions. Suggestion: save the defaults that were actually used (or a 'defaults: true' marker) so the user can see which TP/SL the champion ran with.

2 failures that are older and not related to this change: the local_worker file has VERSION 1.9.0 but the server requires 1.13.0 (test_worker_version_matches_server_requirement, test_package_zip_contains_required_files).

issues: Near-miss text reads 'nur 1 Test-Trades' (wrong German plural for 1, cosmetic)
space_seen_pct shows 4 decimals, e.g. '52.2665% erkundet', and uses a '.' decimal separator inside a German UI

critical_code_review_comments: deep_explore.refine_and_test runs _optimize_trade_settings for every refined candidate (iterations//2, min 10). This is fine, but it is the main per-candidate cost when running with many workers

tests/test_deep_explore.py is a live test against localhost:8001. It creates days=2 explore jobs that become the 'last result' in /api/optimizer/results, so the UI then shows the small test job instead of the user's last real run
